precedence: This addendum overrides only the three clarified wire rules below. All other baseline shapes, state invariants, bindings, routes, ownership and limits remain unchanged. Historical fixtures stay immutable.

clarifications.PC01: Every Python and BFF JSON request boundary rejects raw integer token -0 before normalization. Existing strict integer and duplicate-key rules remain; 0.0 and 0e0 are also rejected for pseudocount. Do not reject string contents merely containing -0.

PC02.scope: Only preprocessing and processed-version routes; do not relax unrelated routes.
PC02.cursor: Existing canonical unpadded base64url UTF8 exact v1/createdAt UTC6/job_id UUID object. Current fixture is 130 characters. Position only; never authority.
PC02.queries: Strict keys, canonical order/encoding, no duplicates; request_id lookup mutually exclusive with limit/cursor. Default/max list limit 10.
PC02.verification: HTTP and BFF must accept actual fixture next_cursor on a second-page request and reject malformed/noncanonical/overlimit inputs. These ceilings are identical at both boundaries.

PC03.rule: Retain existing nonce/session/epoch/Origin gates. This local error is not an API upstream business-error code; upstream cannot impersonate it. Client handles it as invalidated context, not request conflict.

implementation_scope: Backend worker/atomic DB publication/Owner HTTP+BFF and frontend existing report section/client/history/download. No new page/upload entry, inferred design, normalization, imputation, PCA, public deployment or old production changes.
evidence_boundary: Fixtures with placeholder output bytes prove wire shape only. No real R/Owner/database/browser completion follows from this approval.
